resources.string: No favorites yet.\nTap “Browse stations” and star one to add it here.
Could not load stations. Check your connection and try again.
Hide stations that use unencrypted (HTTP) audio streams and block them from playing. Recommended for privacy.

When enabled, the media notification shows the station’s logo. The logo is fetched once on first play and cached locally — subsequent plays do not contact the station’s server for the logo. When disabled, the notification uses a generic media icon and no logo is fetched.
This station uses HTTP. Turn off “HTTPS-only” in Settings to play it.
Hide stations above 128 kbps from the browse list. Useful on metered connections; stations already in your favorites are not affected.
When connected to cellular, apply the low-data filter automatically. Needs the (normal-tier) ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permission to read the connection type.
Low data mode is on — filtered to ≤128 kbps streams
